ctx.x: So upon hearing some of my little tunes that I had begun to create, the students chose me as, you know, one that might want to resurrect the Centrillions, the band that Frank Foster left, and so we brought out, we were give his compositions and we played a few concerts around, and my conducting. So I found a thrill to discover things on the piano that might give me reason to express myself in that medium. So I spent a lot of time on the piano getting my chord changes and I began to write tunes. So when I first…
first composition that I wrote upon arriving in New York City that first year was a tune called “Song of Her.”
